name: Install the kernel's build dependencies
run:
sudo apt-get update -q
sudo apt-get install -y -q --no-install-recommends bc bison flex libelf-dev libssl-dev

name: Install kernel.org GCC 15.2.0 for arm-linux-gnueabi
run:
set -euo pipefail
curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/x86_64-gcc-15.2.0-nolibc-arm-linux-gnueabi.tar.xz" https://mirrors.edge.kernel.org/pub/tools/crosstool/files/bin/x86_64/15.2.0/x86_64-gcc-15.2.0-nolibc-arm-linux-gnueabi.tar.xz
echo "1d76128ba6a2e759a2fa1851c72e95ed6a6e86b97ab0adce5660e62fad23b82a  $RUNNER_TEMP/x86_64-gcc-15.2.0-nolibc-arm-linux-gnueabi.tar.xz" | sha256sum -c -
mkdir -p "$HOME/cross"
tar -xJf "$RUNNER_TEMP/x86_64-gcc-15.2.0-nolibc-arm-linux-gnueabi.tar.xz" -C "$HOME/cross"
"$HOME/cross/gcc-15.2.0-nolibc/arm-linux-gnueabi/bin/arm-linux-gnueabi-"gcc --version
